buildMetadata.note: Public demo: clean Svelte 5 + Pixi 8 build (dev tools excluded) playing the authoritative books.json. 5x3, 10 lines, farm animals + card ranks, Barn-scatter free spins with egg-collect and a Golden Egg bonus. Overall RTP ~94.04% (base ~37.0% + free ~57.0%, 1M-spin sim, seed 42; base is ~2pp under the workbook target, a documented development-stage variance). Maths authority lives in the game-engine repo and is never copied here.
